نحتضن (form VIII)
# نَحْتَضِنُ (naḥtaḍinu) /naħ.ta.dˤi.nu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِحْتَضَنَ (iḥtaḍana)
# نُحْتَضَنُ (nuḥtaḍanu) /nuħ.ta.dˤa.nu/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِحْتَضَنَ (iḥtaḍana)
# نَحْتَضِنَ (naḥtaḍina) /naħ.ta.dˤi.na/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِحْتَضَنَ (iḥtaḍana)
# نُحْتَضَنَ (nuḥtaḍana) /nuħ.ta.dˤa.n
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
